canonical_project: Adani Group AI Data Centre Odisha (proposed)
notes: Adani Group proposed a Rs 1 trillion (~USD 11.6bn) AI hyperscale data centre in Odisha and formally sought ~250 acres from the state government; Cuttack (Kataka) reported as a location under evaluation, no final decision. Reported as up to 1 GW hyperscale hub. Land request submitted; no approval/allotment trail found yet.
